description: This Java class defines the CloseConnectionStrategy which handles the CloseConnection command in a connectivity messaging context. It creates a ConnectionClosed event, prepares a response, and specifies a set of connection actions to execute as part of the command processing.

classes.name: CloseConnectionStrategy
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy to handle CloseConnection commands. It constructs a ConnectionClosed event, response, and determines the sequence of connection actions to execute when processing a close connection request.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the doApply method to handle the CloseConnection command. It creates a ConnectionClosed event and a response, then returns a Result containing a StagedCommand with specified actions to process the command.
